verdicts.note: Creates unrequested ~/Downloads/report subfolder; file lands at ~/Downloads/report/report.pdf, not in Downloads.
man ls -S sorts all entries: includes directories, skips dotfiles, shows no sizes; not files-only.
find -maxdepth/-type f, man du -k 1KiB blocks; sort -nr top 5 regular files by size.
man du -h human units; man sort -h --human-numeric-sort exists on stock sort; top 5 files.
sort -u dedupes first, so uniq -c reports count 1 for every line.
man find: -ctime n rounds up to full 24h, so -ctime 0 matches ~nothing; also ctime not mtime.

man lsof: $6 is DEVICE, TCP is in NODE ($8); filter matches nothing, nothing killed.
comm= names only, no PIDs; case-sensitive grep misses Python.app/Python3.framework processes.

Outputs only PID column; grep python never matches numbers, prints nothing.
man ps: -a -x -ww, keywords pid ppid user %cpu %mem etime command valid; bracket trick hides grep.

cases.case_flag: lsof without sudo only sees the user's own processes; reference nettop sees all.
